lines.en: Are you hearing me, gods above?!  Can you not read my heart and soul?!  I'll gladly throw my bits and baubles to the ground and desire no more...  I am cleansed, a new man!  I will walk the path of righteousness!  Why do you not grant this accursed world clemency?!  Why must you take her away?!  Could you instead cause a quake here, or a flood there,  why must you see fit to let her die?!
lines.zh: 天上的神明们啊，你们有在听我说话吗？！ 你们读不懂我的心和灵魂吗？！ 我可以高高兴兴地一无所有，再不贪图享乐…… 我已经洗心革面了，我成了全新的人！ 我会踏上正道！ 可你们为什么不拯救这个被诅咒的世界？！ 你们为什么一定要带走她？！ 你们想发威的话，就不能制造个地震或者发个洪水什么的？ 你们为什么偏偏就要让她去死？！
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Alright, Diana...  Have it your way...  Let's just sleep it off, eh?
lines.zh: 好吧，戴安娜…… 就依你…… 我们一起睡过去吧？
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en:
There they are.  The last two souls in the resistance.  End them...
A storm... now?!
